rows.html: Journal preparation, approval, posting and adjustment are general-accounting activities.
BlackLine is currently used for MJE preparation, approval and control in legacy ERP.
UNIFY, TITAN, KungPeng: target tool under investigation as BlackLine does not support S/4HANA Public Cloud connectivity.
Allocation engines and accrual automation for general accounting and management accounting.
Accruals and provisions are largely manual, with month-end postings and reversals performed operationally. Allocations are available through ERP allocation cycles.

• SAP AFC for close automation and accrual posting
• AI and automation initiatives under evaluation for provisions
• SAP PaPM for advanced allocations and management accounting calculation
SAP AFC, BlackLine, Redwood, SAP PaPM, Oracle ERP, Workday, SAP Joule
Revenue compliance, contract accounting and WIP.
Mainly managed in legacy ERP with classic revenue recognition. Software and services recurrent revenue models are not fully automated.
Migration to SAP S/4HANA EBRR, supporting project, services and software revenue recognition, IFRS 15 compliance, margin management and subscription accounting.
SAP S/4HANA EBRR, SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting, SAC, Horizon reporting
Manage asset lifecycles, depreciation, lease obligations and compliance.
Fixed Assets & Lease Accounting is mature and largely standardized.
UNIFY has implemented SAP Asset Accounting as the strategic platform for asset lifecycle management, depreciation, transfers, retirement processing and Assets Under Construction.
Inventory valuation, cost calculation, production costing and reserves.
Largely managed in legacy ERP with heterogeneous processes across factories. Further automation is needed for inventory provisions and manufacturing cost calculations.
Global standardization through UNIFY, with SAP S/4HANA enabling harmonized standard costing, event-based production cost posting and improved inventory valuation.
